defects.description: render() emits for any URL, so a reply containing an external image makes the browser request it as soon as it is inserted, leaking whatever the URL carries.
defects.why_missed: The image test uses the app's own path; no test renders an image pointing at another site.

defects.description: render() emits <a> for any URL scheme, so a javascript: link in the reply runs script when clicked.
defects.why_missed: The link test uses an https URL; the HTML escape stops tags, not URL schemes.
